description: The file contains Python test code utilizing pytest for testing QwikTemplate project initialization, configuration, and file generation. It sets up fixtures for temporary directories and mock templates, and includes multiple test cases verifying template info retrieval, project creation, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and variable replacement.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for project parameters such as name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enum representing different project types, including QWIK.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Class holding template initialization information such as environment commands, build commands, and other setup scripts.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects from templates, including loading config, executing post-processing, and handling variable replacements.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Class providing access to templates stored in filesystem directories.

classes.name: QwikTemplate
classes.description: Template class specifically for Qwik projects, providing methods to retrieve init info and generate project files.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Returns TemplateInitInfo object containing environment setup and build commands for the template.

methods.name: initialize_project
methods.description: Performs project initialization: creates files, executes scripts, and applies variable substitutions.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for post-processing scripts to complete execution, indicating initialization completion.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Static method to load project configuration from JSON or YAML files.
